# sq-47 — Layout-only profile option

A profile option that computes the encoding, dialect, layout regions, header names and row classes, and skips the per-field sketches, statistics, hints and evidence. The descriptor marks the sections it left out, so a reader can tell "not computed" from "empty". **Not in this slice:** changing the default profile.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A consumer that only classifies a file reads about 15 descriptor fields and pays for the full profile of a 1 MiB prefix. On wide padded files (about 38 KB per line) the prefix holds only about 25 rows, so the field work buys little. Found in a consumer review, 2026-10-30.
